Infection recovery Its this or we take it to the farm:

While this takes much longer than just wiping the computer clean its nice for when you dont have the OS to reinstall

For windows

1: From a clean computer download the following

Malware bytes

Advast antivirus

2: Copy the installers onto a USB drive or failing that burn them to a CD.

3: (if the computer is turned on) Turn off the infected computer (if needed push and hold the power button to force it to turn off)

4: Turn the computer on and tap the F8 button repeatedly untill you see this screen

5: Select "Safe mode with networking"

6: Login to the admin account

7: Install Malwarebytes, let it update and then run a full system scan (this can take a while so go make a cup of tea and maybe watch TV)

8: After the scan has finished remove everything it found.

9: Remove any antivirus installed on the computer (it has failed you for the last time)

10: Install Advast anti virus update it and run a full system scan

11: again after the scan has finished remove anything it has found.

12: if not already installed download Firefox or Chrome, from inside that do a search for "Adblock plus" and install the addon.

this should leave the computer in a clean state but it does not cover everything that could have ended up on the computer.

Although these instructions have been tested on thousands of computers without incident, and chances of any damage or loss of important data resulting from following these instructions are virtually zero, there always exists a very small chance that something could go wrong.
